topic: Someone finds their partner's bucket list
text: I can't believe I stumbled upon this. A damn bucket list, hidden away like some kind of secret treasure. I knew there was something he wasn't sharing. It’s all there, in his neat, meticulous handwriting: climb Machu Picchu, skydive, write a novel. Nothing about us, about our future. How could he keep this from me? Now I see, everything he dreams of, completely solo. I trusted him, thought we were on the same page. Looks like I was wrong. This list, it’s clear as day. A life he wants, a life that apparently doesn’t include me.
